semiconductor_relevance: High — Japan Laser specializes in advanced inspection and measurement technologies critical for semiconductor fabrication and analysis.
summary: Japan Laser develops innovative inspection and analysis technologies utilizing laser light and optics, focusing on measurement and testing solutions for semiconductor devices and equipment. Their advanced products, such as the AFM-IR device and non-contact surface roughness meters, are designed for high precision in nanofabrication and failure analysis.
capabilities: AFM-IR device for chemical mapping and spectroscopy
Advanced automation for large sample measurements
